授業概要
この授業では、言語の慣習性や定型性に関する講義や、実際の言語表現の収集や分析を実践していく。
In this class, students will receive lectures on the conventionality and formulaicity of language, as well as engage in collecting, extracting, and analyzing target expressions.

全体の教育目標
This course aims to introduce fundamental concepts and methods for effectively and efficiently defining linguistic expressions and collecting them from corpora.
個別の教育目標
- Acquire essential knowledge regarding linguistic conventionality and formulaicity.
- Acquire the basics of collecting and analyzing expressions of multiple words and morphemes.
授業計画
In the first class, we will decide the lecture schedule and the person in charge of the presentation.
In the second to eighth classes, if a lecture is given, the instructor will give a lecture, and if a student is giving a presentation, the instructor will give a presentation and hold a discussion.
The content of the presentation should be one of the following:
(1) A presentation of your research topic and research content
(2) An explanation of a paper you plan to reference in your research.
(3) An analysis of the language data you plan to use in your research
In addition, the topic of the presentation should meet one of the following (a) to (c):
(a) In principle, the subject of the presentation should be English or Japanese.
(If the subject is a language other than English or Japanese, the content of the research should be presented to the instructor before the presentation date)
(b) The subject of the presentation should be a corpus or language data collected by the presenter.
(c) The research should be on the cognitive and social aspects of language (including some aspects of education).
